source.sourceWork: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), Strider before Amon Hen

source.actionName: Coupe de l’épée de rôdeur d’Aragorn
source.pose: Ready sword, physical controlled forward cut, recover to guard; no magic

source.sourceWork: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), Gandalf the Grey
source.appearance: Grey robe, pointed grey hat, long grey beard, wooden staff; Glamdring sheathed when staff is held; not Gandalf the White
source.actionName: Garde du bâton de Gandalf le Gris
source.pose: Raise wooden staff and brace defensively, soft local white staff light only; no bolt or damage

source.sourceWork: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), Lothlorien departure

source.actionName: Flèche du long arc de Legolas
source.pose: Nock one physical arrow, draw bow, release arrow forward, recover

source.sourceWork: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)
